title: Earthquake AI Scientist: A century of global seismicity is stationary after correcting for time-varying catalog completeness from 1900 to 2023

contributions.purpose: 把观测效应与真实地震率变化解耦
contributions.mechanism: completeness-aware 框架:编制 1900-2023 全球目录(37,331 事件,M≳5.5),按 MAXC+0.1 逐年重建 Mc(t)(<50 事件年份剔除),只对 M≥Mc 做 GR 拟合(bootstrap 200-400 次),两代际曝光匹配 Poisson LRT 检验
contributions.evaluation: Mc 十年中位数从 1900s 的 ~6.55 降至 1960s 后 ~5.65(约 0.9 个震级单位),证实上升主要来自检测能力
contributions.domain: 统计地震学 / 目录分析
contributions.source_quote: We compile a 1900-2023 global catalogue (37,331 significant events; minimum M≈5.5) and explicitly reconstruct a time-varying magnitude of completeness, Mc(t), across instrumentation eras.

contributions.purpose: 回答百年地震率是否有长期趋势
contributions.mechanism: 强制完备性后检验十年 b 值与 1900-1959 vs 1960-2023 两代大震率
contributions.evaluation: b 值稳定(中位 1.02,范围 0.84-1.21,95% CI 重叠);M≥7.5 p≈0.40、M≥8.0 p≈0.98 无差异,判定平稳;但 M≥7.0 存在晚期超额(LRT=13.55,p=0.0011),归因阈值邻近伪影
contributions.source_quote: Once Mc(t) is enforced, the apparent secular rise in counts disappears; decadal b-values are stable within uncertainty; and large-earthquake rates are statistically stationary at robust thresholds (notably M ≥ 7.5-8.0).

contributions.purpose: 将平稳基线转化为可操作的十年预测
contributions.mechanism: 以完备性过滤后的晚代速率(λ7.5=4.23/yr、λ8.0=0.83/yr)做平稳 Poisson 外推,并用 ±20% 速率乘子做敏感性包络
contributions.source_quote: for 2025-2034 we predict N10(M ≥ 7.5) = 42.3 events on average (90% interval [32, 53]) and N10(M ≥ 8.0) = 8.3 ([4, 13]), implying ~56% annual probability of at least one M ≥ 8.0 event.

self_declared_provenance.quote: we reconstruct an annual magnitude of completeness, Mc(t), using a conservative frequency-magnitude procedure grounded in established practice [4, 5, 21, 22].
We report LRT values with chi2-based p-values, and rate estimates λi = Ki/Ti (events yr−1), following established practice for count processes.

notes: reject;方法完整、数字充分的实证论文,但存在与主结论相左的混合结果:M≥7.0 两代检验显著晚期超额(LRT=13.55,p=0.0011),作者归因早期 M≈7 附近漏报与震级尺度不均一等伪影而非真实变化——属未独立验证的解释。披露矛盾:AI Involvement Checklist 四类全答 [A](Human-generated,人类≥95%),但各项 Explanation 自述 AI 自主提出假设、生成实验设计、完成全部分析与制图,类别选择与解释文字直接冲突(按解释更接近 C/D)。Paper Checklist 多项 Justification 留 [TODO],Limitations 项直接答 No(未讨论局限);正文称数据与代码 available upon request,checklist 却称 will open-source,前后不一。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+discussion 归纳。
